items.name: P1-APPLY-01 Submit application end-to-end
items.description: 1. Open public apply form URL for test school. 2. Fill Student First Name, Last Name, DOB, Year Level, Campus. 3. Upload test PDF (<5MB). 4. Click Submit. 5. Verify confirmation page. 6. Log in as admin > Applications list. Expected: Application created, confirmation email sent, visible in admin.

items.name: P1-APPLY-02 Hidden fields not in notifications
items.description: Configure signup form with hidden fields set to No. Submit as parent. Check notification email. Expected: Hidden fields do NOT appear in email (ET-9039 fix).

items.name: P1-APPLY-03 Stage filter present
items.description: Navigate to Applications list > Filters. Look for Stage filter. Expected: Stage filter present and functional (ET-9188).

items.name: P1-STU-01 Add student (boarding disabled)
items.description: Select school with boarding disabled. Click Add Student. Fill First Name, Last Name, Year Level. Save. Expected: Student created without error (ET-9110).

items.name: P1-STU-02 Save student address
items.description: Open student details > Student Residence. Enter street, city, state, postcode. Save. Expected: Address saved and displayed correctly (ET-9183).

items.name: P1-STU-03 Zone Catcher status on student
items.description: Add student with address inside zone boundary. Wait for geocoding. Open student details. Expected: Zone Catcher shows In Zone status.

items.name: P1-AUTH-01 WorkOS SSO login (AU)
items.description: Navigate to app.enquirytracker.net. Click SSO login. Complete SAML flow. Expected: Logged in, no page refresh loop.

items.name: P1-AUTH-02 Regular email/password login
items.description: Navigate to login page. Enter email and password. Click Login. Expected: Logged in via non-SSO path.

items.name: P1-MAP-01 Upload KML file
items.description: Settings > Map Layers > Upload. Select valid KML with polygon. Assign to campus. Expected: File uploaded, polygon stored, layer displayed.

items.name: P1-MAP-02 Zone Catcher In Zone
items.description: Upload zone boundary. Add student with address inside zone. Wait for computation. Expected: Student details show In Zone badge.

items.name: P1-MAP-03 Student list filter by Zone Catcher
items.description: Students list > Filters > Zone Catcher > In Zone. Expected: Only students with In Zone status shown (ET-9069).

items.name: P1-PORTAL-01 Signature capture on apply form
items.description: Open apply form with signature field. Draw signature. Submit. Expected: Signature captured and saved (ET-6070).

items.name: P2-FAM-01 Family Type in Student Details
items.description: Open student details. Find Family Type dropdown. Select value. Save. Expected: Value saved and displayed (ET-3708).

items.name: P2-FAM-02 Family Type filter
items.description: Students list > Filters > Family Type. Expected: Results filtered correctly (ET-3707).

items.name: P2-CG-01 Class Groups on signup forms
items.description: Open signup form with Class Groups enabled. Expected: Class Groups dropdown visible (ET-9103).

items.name: P2-ANA-01 Geographic map with addresses
items.description: Analytics > Geographic. Expected: Student addresses plotted on map (ET-9142).

items.name: P2-LS-01 Zone Catcher in Lead Score
items.description: Admin > Lead Score. Add Zone Catcher criterium. Set points for In/Out Zone. Check student scores. Expected: Scoring applied correctly (ET-9150).

items.name: P2-TASK-01 Create task
items.description: Tasks page > Create Task. Fill title and details. Save. Expected: Task created and visible in list.

items.name: P3-CSV-01 Export Family Type
items.description: Students > Export CSV. Expected: Family Type column present in export.

items.name: P3-MERGE-01 Merge with Family Type
items.description: Select two students with different Family Types. Open merge. Choose preferred value. Merge. Expected: Correct value preserved (ET-4209).

items.name: P3-INFRA-01 Version number display
items.description: Login. Check version in footer or settings. Expected: Shows v26.1.0 format (ET-8898).

items.name: Enquiry creation and filters
items.description: Create enquiry. Apply filters by status. Expected: Enquiry saved, filters work.

items.name: Event form submit
items.description: Open event registration form. Fill and submit. Expected: Registration saved.

items.name: Send notification email
items.description: Communications > Send message. Expected: Email sent, Dittofeed iframe loads.

items.name: ET-9395 TasksReminders error on every page
items.description: When TasksReminders feature flag disabled, 'This action is not allowed for this role' error appears on every page. Expected: No error when flag disabled.

items.name: ET-9392 Subtours order on event webform
items.description: Subtours/Interview Times not in correct order on event webform. St Joseph's Mundingburra. Expected: Chronological order by start time.

items.name: ET-9379 Sanity check: single test crash blocks all
items.description: When sanity check test throws exception, all subsequent tests skipped. Fix: wrap in try/except, continue.

items.name: ET-9368 Student Interests Include in List
items.description: Admin > School Lists > Student Interests does not honor Include in List on Apply forms. Brisbane South State Secondary.

items.name: ET-9351 geocode-contact worker lock timeout
items.description: geocode-contact BullMQ worker fails with Lock wait timeout. Fix: reduce concurrency 10→3.

items.name: ET-9329 geocode-student deadlocks
items.description: geocode-student worker: deadlocks, transaction commit failures. ~24 errors/10min on dev.

items.name: ET-9257 reCAPTCHA already rendered
items.description: Error: reCAPTCHA has already been rendered in this element. Sentry ENROLLMENT_ANGULAR-1TW.

items.name: ET-9033 Delete documents in In Progress apps
items.description: School user can delete documents when previewing In Progress apps. Expected: Delete button hidden for in-progress.

items.name: ET-8933 reprovisionSchool Dittofeed error
items.description: reprovisionSchool job fails with UserPropertyAlreadyExists from Dittofeed. 11.6% schools affected.

items.description: E2E test for Submit Apply form form. Full flow automation.
